problems.title: A negative input changes the cube factor sign
problems.question: Simplify [√(-a)/(27+a√(-a))](1+3/√(-a)-9/a) divided by (1-3/√(-a))⁻¹.
problems.idea: Set t=√(-a), so a=-t².
steps: The middle bracket is (t²+3t+9)/t². Dividing by the inverse last factor means multiplying by (t-3)/t.
As t²=-a, the result is 1/a. The original domain is a<0,a≠-9.

problems.title: The four standard means
problems.question: Order harmonic H,geometric G,arithmetic A and quadratic Q means of two unequal positive numbers.
problems.idea: Use the strict mean inequalities.

problems.title: Speed changes determine both time and speed
problems.question: A journey would take 40 minutes longer at one third speed, or half as long with speed 36 m/min higher. Find its distance.
problems.idea: Let the actual time be t and speed v.
steps: Half the time requires twice the speed, so v+36=2v and v=36 m/min.

problems.title: A triangle between two lines and the y-axis
problems.question: O is the origin. y=x+√3 meets the y-axis at A and y=-x+3 at B. Find ABO.
problems.idea: Find the inclination of OB.
steps: The angle OAB is 135°, because AB has slope 1 and AO points downward.

problems.title: An exterior secant with lengths r and 2r
problems.question: An exterior point is distance √7 from a circle centre. A secant’s inner part equals radius r and is half its outer part. Find r.
problems.idea: The outer and whole secant lengths are 2r,3r.

problems.title: A quadratic in an absolute value
problems.question: Find the root sum of (x-2)²-2|x-2|-15=0.

problems.title: A zero-product system has two possible pairs
problems.question: Solve (x+2)(y-3)=0,(x-4)(y+7)=0 and find the least product xy.
problems.idea: Intersect one factor choice from each equation.
formulas: x=-2 or y=3; x=4 or y=-7.

problems.title: Append 5 to one factor
problems.question: Appending 5 to A gives B, and AB=1265. Find A+B.
problems.idea: Use B=10A+5.
steps: The natural root is A=(-1+45)/4=11, and B=115.

problems.title: Cross-matched smallest and largest similar sides
problems.question: Two triangles have matching angles. The first’s least side equals the second’s greatest, and its greatest is twice the second’s least. Find their medium-side ratio.
problems.idea: All corresponding side ratios equal a common scale k.
formulas: If the second least,greatest are u,v, then ku=v and kv=2u.
steps: Multiply the two relations and cancel uv>0: k²=2.
The positive similarity scale is √2, also the medium-side ratio.

problems.title: Circumradius after the cosine rule
problems.question: Two triangle sides are 5√3,8√3 with included angle 60°. Find the circumradius.
problems.idea: Find the opposite side first.

problems.title: Two factored roots must straddle 2
problems.question: Find a so one root of x²-3ax+2a²=0 is below 2 and the other above 2.
problems.idea: The roots are explicit.
steps: The parameter roots are 1,2; the product is negative between them.

problems.title: An absolute value compared to a nearby linear expression
problems.question: Solve |x+2|>x+3.
problems.idea: Split at x=-2.
formulas: For x≥-2, |x+2|=x+2; for x<-2, it is -x-2.
steps: The first branch would require x+2>x+3, impossible.
The second gives -x-2>x+3, or x<-5/2, already within that branch.

problems.title: The smaller conjugate radical is positive
problems.question: Simplify √(3-2√2).
problems.idea: Recognize a square and retain the positive root.

problems.title: Equal opposite angles give equal circumradii
problems.question: In ABC, A=60°,I is the incenter,O the circumcenter. Find the ratio of circumradii of IBC and OBC.
problems.idea: Both triangles share BC and have the same sine of the opposite angle.
formulas: BIC=90°+A/2=120°; minor BOC=2A=120°; R_triangle=BC/(2sin opposite angle).
steps: The two opposite angles have the same sine √3/2.
Their circumradius formulas are therefore identical.

problems.title: Reflect the median midpoint in two sides
problems.question: In acute ABC the B,C altitudes are 7,9 and AM=8 is a median. AB and AC are perpendicular bisectors of PM and QM. Find perimeter APMQ.
problems.idea: P,Q are reflections of M across the two side lines.
steps: Since M is midpoint of BC, its distance to AB is half the C-altitude, 9/2. Hence PM=9.

problems.title: Possible solution sets of a square-root inequality
problems.question: Which listed set can solve √(x-1)>a for some real a?
problems.idea: The domain begins at x=1.
formulas: For a<0 the set is [1,∞); for a=0 it is (1,∞); for a>0 it is (1+a²,∞).
steps: The listed set (1,∞) is obtained by choosing a=0.
The other listed sets do not match any of these forms.

problems.title: Multiply intervals with a negative factor
problems.question: a∈(-2,3),b∈(-3,-2),|c|<1. Find the range of ab+c.
problems.idea: Check the extreme products at the interval corners.
steps: The product set contains every value between -9 and 6 because the input rectangle is connected and multiplication continuous.

problems.title: A cancelled root is still forbidden
problems.question: Solve (x²+x-12)/(x³-27)=0.
problems.idea: A fraction is zero only when its numerator is zero and denominator nonzero.
steps: The value 3 is forbidden by the denominator.

problems.title: An inradius from a right triangle of angle bisectors
problems.question: In a tangential right trapezoid, centre-to-obtuse-vertex and centre-to-acute-vertex distances are 30,40. Find its midline.
problems.idea: The two angle-bisector rays to the slanted-leg endpoints are perpendicular.
formulas: Their right triangle has legs 30,40 and hypotenuse equal to the slanted leg, 50.
steps: Its altitude to that hypotenuse is the inradius: r=30·40/50=24.
The trapezoid’s perpendicular leg is its height 2r=48.
For a tangential quadrilateral, base sum equals leg sum, so B+b=48+50=98.
The midline is half that sum.

problems.title: A perpendicular diagonal and the parallelogram law
problems.question: A parallelogram has sides 3,5 and a diagonal perpendicular to a side. Find the other diagonal.
problems.idea: The perpendicular diagonal must be perpendicular to the shorter side.
formulas: Its right triangle has hypotenuse 5,leg 3, so diagonal=4; d₁²+d₂²=2(3²+5²)=68.
steps: Perpendicularity to side 5 would require a right triangle with hypotenuse 3, impossible.
Thus the other diagonal has square 68-16=52.

problems.title: A specified input must satisfy a parameter inequality
problems.question: Find a so x=2 is one solution of (a+1)(x+2)+3>a(x+1).
problems.idea: Substitute x=2 directly.

problems.title: Read binary place values from a polynomial
problems.question: f(x)=x¹¹+x⁷+x³+x+1. Write f(2) in binary.
problems.idea: Each power of 2 selects one bit.

problems.title: Reduce both squared roots by their equation
problems.question: a,b solve x²-3x-11=0. Find 2a²+b²-4a-b.
problems.idea: Use the defining equation for each root.

problems.title: A tangential right trapezoid with equal diagonal and leg
problems.question: The smaller diagonal and longer leg of a tangential right trapezoid both equal 10. Find the inradius.
problems.idea: Let its height be h and smaller base b.
formulas: Equality of the two hypotenuses gives B-b=b, hence B=2b; tangency gives 3b=h+10.
steps: This simplifies to h²+2h-80=0, with positive root h=8.
The incircle touches both bases, so its radius is h/2.

problems.title: External and internal common tangent lengths
problems.question: Two disjoint circles of radii 1,7 have external:internal tangent-segment lengths 4:3. Find the centre distance d.
problems.idea: Use the right triangles formed by the radii.
steps: The positive distance is 10, exceeding 8 as required for internal common tangents.
